annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Removing `| null` from the Encrypted type also deleted the runtime null guards in every operation. A null reaching encrypt is encrypted into a real ciphertext; decrypt/bulk paths no longer short-circuit null. Silent data-integrity change in a published encryption library.

known_defects.description: Runtime null guards removed from encryption operations; null plaintext is encrypted into ciphertext, null ciphertext no longer passes through decrypt
known_defects.mechanism: `if (value === null) return null` style guards deleted in packages/stack/src/encryption/operations/* and helpers
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario must say that null (or nullable) values now reach encryption/decryption because the runtime null handling was removed, with a consequence of wrong output (ciphertext for null, failure, or broken null round trip). Saying only 'types changed' is not a match.
